contexts.text: He that persevereth to the end shall be saved () = the salvation of those who are in charity. He that persevereth to the end = him who does not suffer himself to be seduced; thus who does not yield in temptations.
The reason the Jews persevere in the denial of the Lord...
Man... must then persevere even to the end of life.
In proportion as a man perseveres in this intention, he is initiated into the purity and holiness of (conjugial love). CL 146:end.
If the wife perseveres in chaste favour...
From this the continuance of this love follows.
If you persevere thus, reciprocal conjunction will take place...
Perseverance in love and faith. Signified.
For he who perseveres even till death in love and faith is saved...
